method: Read-only source/test review plus one fake-provider, inert-span reproduction. No provider/API/backend calls or source changes.

blockers.finding: The nonempty-claims guard applies only to Candidate.kind=answer. partial_candidate creates kind=insufficient. A valid-shaped verdict with passed=true and claims=[] therefore passes a factual recovery candidate without identifying any checked claim.

resolution.change: Recovery requires at least one checked product claim, independently of Candidate.kind. Existing partial/unsupported and cited-evidence guards still apply.

verified_controls: Only support-mode verdicts can produce a recovery candidate; off and support+coverage modes are excluded.
At most four supported product claims with known source entries and URLs are selected; C execution records and backtick code fences are excluded.
Candidate inline/structured citations are checked before the call.
The entire reconstructed candidate receives one additional normal verifier call, with current and relevant prior evidence.
Original failed attempts remain in verification_attempts; recovery is separately flagged and model usage is included in normal metering.
UI displays Checked points / partial answer, and kind remains insufficient; it does not label the original task completed.
Failed normal recheck withholds candidate text.
After commit 9518441, recovery also requires at least one checked product claim; empty or research-process-only verdicts cannot release factual recovered bullets.
remaining_limits: Supported-claim labels and the new recheck remain fallible model judgments; extraction can lose useful qualifications or relevance.

The helper rejects supplied structured missing/uncertain coverage, but support-mode verify clears coverage because that mode does not perform a coverage assessment. This is not a guarantee of completeness or of detecting every already-known omission.
The no-code filter detects backtick fences and C-source observations, not every possible code representation or execution-language phrase; the final factual recheck remains necessary.
The real receipt validates one narrowed response, not recovery of a complete answer. It explicitly omits the requested relationship between the three features.
The v4 tracing answer did not use recovery, so that live case is not end-to-end recovery evidence.
